worksheet.title: Product Ideas Worksheet
worksheet.description: Score and shortlist your product ideas using real evidence before committing to one.

fields.label: Idea description
fields.helpText: Describe the product in one sentence. Be specific: 'reusable water bottle' is too broad, 'insulated water bottle for trail runners' is useful.

fields.label: Demand evidence
fields.helpText: What did you find that suggests people are already looking for this? Bestseller ranks, search volumes, review counts, community posts: any real signal counts.

fields.label: Competition notes
fields.helpText: How many sellers are already doing this well? Is there a gap you could fill, or is the market saturated?

fields.label: Seasonality
fields.helpText: Does demand for this product peak at certain times of year, or is it consistent?
